name: previews

steps.action: C28 step 1-4: a PDF opens in the reader, its page controls work, and Download returns the uploaded bytes
steps.actual: The Document name opened the PDF reader showing the v… indicator and the five controls the guide names; Download returned bytes identical to the upload and reading added no Version

steps.action: C28 step 5: Word and PowerPoint read as a converted PDF while the download stays the original file
steps.actual: Both office formats reached a ready PDF rendition and drew pages in the reader; each Download still returned the uploaded DOCX/PPTX byte for byte, and the rendition never became a second Version

steps.action: C28 step 34: an image-only scan is OCR'd in the background for text search
steps.actual: The scan's extracted text arrived with source "ocr" and 107 characters while the reader still showed the original scanned pages and the download stayed the original scan

steps.action: C28 step 34: processed text is findable through the app's global search
steps.actual: A word that exists only inside the uploaded file's text was typed into the app's global search and returned this Document — the guide is right to send readers there for words inside processed paper

steps.action: C28: a raster image draws inline and downloads unchanged
steps.actual: The PNG drew as an inline image in the reader and its Download matched the uploaded bytes

steps.action: C28 step 28: an email shows headers, body and attachments; only PDF/image attachments preview
steps.actual: The email reader showed the subject, sender and a 2 attachments strip, fetched nothing from the remote image host, opened the PDF attachment in a preview and offered the Word attachment as a download; neither attachment became a managed Document

steps.action: C28 step 26: a download-only format downloads straight from the row
steps.actual: The CSV row was a download link rather than a reader button: selecting the name downloaded the original directly, with no preview opened

steps.action: C28 step 32: the reader shows the preparing card while a rendition is still pending
steps.actual: With the rendition read held at pending, the reader drew "Preparing this document for reading…" exactly as quoted; the stored original was downloadable throughout and the real rendition was already ready

steps.action: C28 step 36: an unreadable file shows the failure card and a corrected Version recovers it
steps.actual: The intentionally damaged DOCX reached a failed rendition and drew the guide’s exact recovery card while its original still downloaded unchanged; appending a readable file produced a v2 that rendered, and the failed v1 stayed in the chain

steps.action: C28 step 38: a download can fail on its own while previews keep working
steps.actual: After the Document was permanently removed, its Version download answered 404 and its row was gone, while a different Document still previewed and downloaded normally — the guide is right that a failed download is a separate outcome from a failed preview, and re-uploading would not bring the erased bytes back
